Initially trained the model using Convolutional Neural Network in TensorFlow, then convert the .h5 output into .mlmodel. Use it in the application. please check : https://github.com/ashislaha/CarDetection-Keras & https://github.com/ashislaha/CarDetection-iOS for more details how to train a model.  -- In ARFrame generates capturedImage which is the input to .mlmodel for detecting that car is present in the image or not.  -- This project combines both ARKit & CoreML.
